SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM V_VOC_ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = X.DS_DEPT AND SYS_TYPE='KA') DS_DEPT_NAME, X.FLAG_DC, X.FLAG_PS, X.FLAG_PA, X.FLAG_FB, (X.FLAG_DC+X.FLAG_PS+X.FLAG_PA+X.FLAG_FB) AS T_FLAG, X.DS_DEPT FROM ( SELECT A.DS_DEPT, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'DC',1)),0) AS FLAG_DC, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'PS',1)),0) AS FLAG_PS, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'PA',1)),0) AS FLAG_PA, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'FB',1)),0) AS FLAG_FB FROM KEPAVCDT A, (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND TEXT3 = 'C') B WHERE TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{st_fromDate} AND #{st_toDate} AND A.CLAIM_TYPE = B.CODE
AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('DC','PS')
AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('DC','PS','PA','FB')
AND A.DS_DEPT IN (#{st_ds_dept_code})
AND A.DS_USER_ID IN (#{st_ds_user_id})
GROUP BY A.DS_DEPT ) X ORDER BY 1
